'''Imperial News Network''' was a "civilian" branch of the [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Media (Imperial Intelligence)|Media Division]]. [[Ilo Jev/Legends|Ilo Jev]] worked for Imperial News Network at one point in this career.
